author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at Myrient, a site that hosts the largest repository of gaming related files. Preservation is a big deal to me especially with games that aren't sold officially for the most part anymore and to lose terabytes of content because of AI slop and paywallers is just sad to see. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Bad Day For Gamers...
